text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sprinted through the first three years of the Twinkle Series
alongside Ikuno Dictus. Yet, the busy days
continued just as before.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—If an Umamusume's condition changes, how should I input that into "IRON WILL"?
I wonder if it can account for mental slumps too.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, could you explain this data on Ikuno Dictus in more detail?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: I see. Through learning, "IRON WILL" has begun to take the Umamusume's individuality into account.
choice_data_list: Yes. In order to facilitate the AI's learning...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you as always, that really helps.
I've brewed some black tea, so please enjoy."
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Buzz, buzz)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My phone vibrates, so I excuse myself from the other Trainers to check it. It was a task notification. On the screen were the words 'Hot Springs Trip.'
choice_data_list: That's it, the hot springs trip voucher!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up the lecture on "IRON WILL," I hurried over to Ikuno Dictus.
She was already training as usual.
choice_data_list: Let's go to the hot springs, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right.
I was reminded of that hot spring voucher I won in the lottery."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's go.
Body maintenance is essential, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the hot springs trip.
Ikuno Dictus had brought quite a lot of luggage.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what would you like to drink on the train?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We have tea, water, and coffee.
If you haven't eaten breakfast yet,
we also have rice balls and stuffed breads.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything listed is food and drink
that I usually enjoy.
To think they even accounted for when I skip breakfast...
choice_data_list: That's Ikuno for you, so thoughtful!
That's Ikuno for you, so thoughtful!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
These past three years spent together with you weren't just for show, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please leave the support during our journey to me as well.
I have completed all my advance research thoroughly.
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"We have arrived.
However, the real journey starts from here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before heading into the inn, we took a stroll through the hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That old-fashioned game parlor was quite enjoyable.
—Since we moved around so much, are you feeling a bit hungry?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's enjoy a food tour together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Hot spring steamed buns, onsen carrots, croquettes,
soft-serve ice cream... There are also places where you can buy vegetables and eggs to steam in the hot spring!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What is your stomach
in the mood for, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's a hot spring manju?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The closest shop is a long-established one where you can enjoy classic flavors.
If you prefer it less sweet, there's a shop 25 meters ahead, and for unique options like custard, 40 meters ahead—
choice_data_list: You looked into it that much!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since I always have trouble deciding which shop to go to.
If we look it up beforehand, we can choose without any regrets, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her preliminary research let us have a total blast,
and yet she still has more tricks up her sleeve?
choice_data_list: Can I squeal with joy?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I shall make sure
those screams never stop.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you like to go to the 2nd-floor
lounge before dinner?
Apparently, there's going to be a Japanese drum performance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's an opening act before the show starts.
It might be best to head over early.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the lounge, the crowd was sparse.
Right after taking a seat, an announcement for an upcoming event came over the PA system.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's going to get crowded soon.
I'm glad we were able to secure good seats.
choice_data_list: Ikuno's been a real lifesaver today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear you say that.
Please look forward to what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to deliver
the greatest travel experience to you with my own hands, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted a massage chair near the grand bath.
A massage right after soaking in the hot springs would work wonders.
Just as I was about to sit downâ

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: Whoa, you scared me! You were there?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...A massage, is it?
I humbly believe that fingers can make far more delicate adjustments than any machine, however.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If it's alright with you, I could...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even reply, Ikuno Dictus urged me to sit,
and I ended up getting a shoulder massage from her.
The moderate pressure felt so soothing.
choice_data_list: Just as you said, it's way better than a machine.
Just like you said, it's way better than a machine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer.
I am terribly sorry!
choice_data_list: Huh!? What brought this on, so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Saying that fingers were better than the machine earlier was just an excuse on the spot!
choice_data_list: An excuse?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...This trip is meant for maintaining both of our bodies.
That is why I was... preparing for it."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, since I didn't mention it to you,
you were free to do whatever you liked, Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The words just slipped out on their own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is rambling rather vaguely, which is rare for her.
In other words, was she preparing
to give me a massage...?
choice_data_list: It's fine, you don't need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
I have used other excuses as well."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"When you asked me to go to the hot springs with you,
I acted as if I had just remembered, but..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I remembered.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"So before that...
I had actually gone to the Trainer Lounge."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I promised I'd remind you
if you happened to forget, Trainer...
choice_data_list: ! Sorry, I didn't notice!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I knew you were busy.
I was waiting for your conversation to finish.
However...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I saw another Trainer serving you tea...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it... I had left the room.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “I deeply apologize for my dishonesty and for trying to paper things over with a lie.”
choice_data_list: It really doesn't bother me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No! I am fully aware that this is
a grave breach of trust that shakes our relationship!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am so inexperienced that I cannot even manage my own mentality,
but please... please, do not give up on me...
choice_data_list: I'm not exasperated at all. You're just very diligent, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You could have just kept quiet about it.
Yet you honestly confessed to me,
feeling that you had been dishonest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was so earnest it almost made me feel bad.
Yet, seeing how far she was willing to go not to lose
my trust filled me with pure happiness.
choice_data_list: I must stay true to your sincerity as well.
I have to stay true to your sincerity as well

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
You are already sincere enough. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you tell me
that you still trust me as you always have.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Could you grant me one request?
choice_data_list: What could it be?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...A water bottle, so you can drink in the break room in the future.
May I prepare one for you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an
irreplaceable bond between Ikuno Dictus and myself...
